paragraphs: Giddel bar Menashi; in chapter Arvei Pesachim: bar Menashya. He reported Rav: Moed Katan 24b. In chapter Mi Shemet, 155b: bar Menashi sent to Rava, “Let our master teach us.” In Rashbam: he sent to Rav. But in Asheri and Rif it says “to Rava” several times; perhaps this is someone else. However, I saw in Moed Katan 24a that he reported Shmuel. It appears that he lived in the time of Rav and Shmuel. The author of Sheerit Yosef did not include him among Rav’s students; this requires examination.
